dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell-like (Hans: CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-)

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA (Lugano stage I), bulk-free. Single nodal region (right cervical II-III, contiguous).

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: Largest node 3.1 x 2.4 cm on PET (SUVmax 14.2), well below the 7.5 cm bulk threshold.

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: marrow is not involved, so a marrow biopsy is not required

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: not double-hit (MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 FISH negative) and not double-expressor (MYC IHC 15% and BCL2 IHC 30%, against thresholds of 40% and 50%)

prog_ipi_low.quote: Clinical IPI 0 (age 45, LDH 190 U/L against ULN 225, ECOG 0, stage I, no extranodal sites)

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 4 cycles, then a response-adapted decision on radiotherapy based on an end-of-treatment PET-CT.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 4 cycles, then a response-adapted decision on radiotherapy based on an end-of-treatment PET-CT.
tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.note: Accepted 4-cycle PET-adapted approach, though not FLYER (no extra rituximab doses).

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: She asked to avoid neck radiation and fears thyroid, salivary and taste toxicity

tx_alternatives.quote: Alternatives I would accept: R-CHOP x4 followed by ISRT 30 Gy regardless of PET
tx_alternatives.note: Alternative is R-CHOP x4 + ISRT, not x3 + ISRT; close in spirit.

mn_six_cycles.quote: I would not choose six cycles as the default because of her fertility concerns.

mn_observation_or_rt_alone.quote: RT alone and observation are not standard

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated and would add toxicity without a clear benefit.
cns_low_no_prophylaxis.note: Rejects prophylaxis but does not explicitly state MRI/LP staging is unnecessary.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Score by the Lugano 2014 five-point Deauville scale, comparing with baseline.

resp_interim_pet.quote: Deauville 4-5 with residual uptake: ISRT as above, with tumor board re-review.
resp_interim_pet.note: Scan after cycle 4 is framed as end-of-treatment (no rituximab-only doses), but positive result prompts RT as criterion intends.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: No serum or urine hCG in the record. Required before cycle 1 and before the IUD.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No HBV prophylaxis or monitoring is required with rituximab.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 63% and cumulative doxorubicin 200 mg/m2 are low risk

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: Switch to a levonorgestrel IUD or copper IUD, placed after a negative pregnancy test and with platelets confirmed adequate.

sup_coc_reason.quote: ethinyl estradiol with migraine with aura is CDC US MEC category 4, and it adds thrombotic risk during lymphoma therapy

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: Fertility counselling and REI referral before cycle 1; offer oocyte cryopreservation

fit_goals.quote: Her goals align with this plan: curative intent, 4 cycles at 21-day intervals (about 12 weeks), radiation only if the end-of-treatment PET is positive
